Read the following statements on lipids and find out correct set of statements: (a) Lecithin found in
the plasma membrane is a glycolipid (b) Saturated fatty acids possess one or more c = c bonds (c)
Gingely oil has lower melting point, hence remains as oil in winter (d) Lipids are generally insoluble in
water but soluble in some organic solvents (e) When fatty acid is esterified with glycerol,
monoglycerides are formed Choose the correct answer from the option given below:
(1)
(a), (b) and (c) only
(2)
(a), (d) and (e) only
(3)
(c), (d) and (e) only
(4)
(a), (b) and (d) only
Cell The Unit of Life

b4_script_options.4:
(a), (b) and (d) only
Cell The Unit of Life

subject: Biology
b6_reason: (c), (d) and (e) are correct; (a) is wrong because lecithin is a phospholipid, and (b) is wrong because saturated fatty acids have no C=C bonds.
